programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dustin, Chance & Nova say mom Sonya, is a liar & manipulator, neglecting them--deplorable conditions, no food, no hot water. They say mom bought fast food for herself & her boyfriend as they starved. Then she disappeared. Sonya says she doesn't remember.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tammy & Mark say they haven't spoken to their son, Cory, in a year as his wife, Katrina, is literally-- a witch! Katrina, a self-proclaimed "witch," says her inlaw's judge. Cory denies his wife controls him & he's against the poor treatment of his wife.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Heather & Brian, feuding parents over 15-yr-old son Brandon's death. Hear from Brandon's friends, the last to see him alive and two of the young men make shocking allegations against Heather. How does she respond?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: An emotional intervention on Dr. Phil's stage: Siblings Sarah and PJ say for the past two years their mom, Kim, chose alcohol and pills over her four children. With father Pete headed to prison for mail fraud in a few weeks, the family is falling apart.

programme.title: Tu As Crie Let Me Go
programme.desc: In "Tu as crié LET ME GO," Anne Claire Poirier explores her daughter's tragic descent into drugs and prostitution, seeking understanding of the societal pressures influencing young people's risky behaviors in Montreal's streets.

programme.title: Le Grand Serpent Du Monde
programme.desc: A young forty-something, Tom Paradise refuses to grow up. Behind the wheel of his bus he drives endlessly through the city, tracing out the path of his life, dreaming of the landscape of the American West that forever impressed him

programme.title: Adams World
programme.desc: Adam's World present a short lecture by Elizabeth Dodson Gray, a feminist theologian, environmentalist, and futurist. She speaks to us about the severity of our global environmental crisis, and analyzes the root cause of this crisis.

programme.title: Very Nice Very Nice
programme.desc: Arthur Lipsett's debut film peels back life's facade, revealing hidden anxieties beneath. Through familiar images and fragmented speech, it critiques societal norms, punctuated by the recurring phrase, "Very nice, very nice."

programme.title: Writer In The Nuclear Age A Conversation With Margaret Laurence
programme.desc: Margaret Laurence tackles peace-related issues in this short film: writer's social responsibility, language's impact, nuclear threat, and more. Ideal for sparking discussions across various subjects.

programme.title: The Tender Tale Of Cinderella Penguin
programme.desc: Medieval-style animation twists Cinderella with a mistreated penguin. Hilarity ensues when she loses her magic flipper, saved by Prince Charming. A wordless film with a unique fairy tale twist.

programme.title: Sylvies Story
programme.desc: The film shows Sylvie in a Montréal transition house, highlighting the hurdles of violence, loneliness, and scarcity. It emphasizes sharing experiences and transition houses' support in connecting victims with legal and social aid.

programme.title: Danish Poet, The
programme.desc: Can we trace the chain of events that leads to our own birth? Is our existence just coincidence? The Danish Poet considers these questions as we follow a poet whose creative well has run dry, on a holiday to Norway to meet a famous writer.

programme.title: Ryan
programme.desc: Ryan is based on the life of Ryan Larkin, a Canadian animator who, 30 years ago, produced some of the most influential animated films of his time.

programme.title: How They Saw Us Careers And Cradles
programme.desc: Made in 1947, this transitional film uses the celebration of token women of achievement as a way of justifying marriage as a career. It points to the emphasis on femininity and consumerism in the 1950s.

programme.title: Bloomberg: The China Show
programme.desc: From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors insight into the world's second-biggest economy, delivering in-depth discussions with newsmakers.

programme.title: Insight with Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
programme.desc: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa, linking the market drivers from overnight in the U.S. and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep-dive analysis of the top businesses.

programme.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe
programme.desc: From London, essential morning viewing to stay ahead of the day's market trends with news stories from the U.S. and Asia in the lead-up to the opening of European markets.

programme.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
programme.desc: "The Opening Trade" explores things to know as markets open across Europe; analysis that isn't available anywhere else, a break down of the biggest stories of the day and top guests who have skin in the game.
